g.text: SIS / BMS / ESD / F&G - CDU / VDU
H-101 FG control to min / track
H-101 fans to purge (keep running), damper open
H-201 coil steam to max (sweep coils)
Signal to OSBL fire-water pumps / deluge
H-101 arch pressure high-high / ID fan loss
D-105 level low-low (gas blow-by to LPG)
P-112 area fire - manual / F&G confirmed
P-204 area fire - manual / F&G confirmed
Confirmed gas - C-101 / strippers / OH system & pumps
Confirmed fire - C-101 / strippers / OH system & pumps
Confirmed gas - Light ends C-105/C-106 & LPG pumps
Confirmed fire - Light ends C-105/C-106 & LPG pumps
Confirmed gas - Fired heaters H-101/H-201 & FG KO
Confirmed fire - Fired heaters H-101/H-201 & FG KO
Confirmed gas - VDU C-201, ejectors & hotwell
Confirmed fire - VDU C-201, ejectors & hotwell
LEGEND: X = trip / close (de-energise) O = open P = purge / safe position, controller to manual-track A = alarm. Shaded rows = F&G confirmed events.
1. SIS / BMS hosted in the SIL 3-capable logic solver (separate from DCS); BMS per NFPA 85/86 & API 556. All trips latch; reset from CCR after initiator healthy and purge / permissives complete.

2. Set points derived from process_results / psv data (set-point basis in RPT-002); vendor confirmation required. F&G: 2ooN confirmed gas (20 % LEL alarm, 50 % LEL action) or fire; layout per mapping study.
3. SIF-204 ROSOVs fire-safe, close <= 30 s. SIF-109 = D-105 LL -> XV-1093 (SIF list revision).
